profile.beat: Growth equities, healthcare and consumer turnarounds alongside crypto, metals and macro rotation.
profile.style: Forceful conviction language, Elliott Wave projections and long-term moving averages dominate. Claims fundamentals guide chart-based entries and frequently recounts successful earlier calls. Portfolio guidance stresses cash, safe havens and avoiding leverage.
profile.cadence: Frequent daily one-liners, chart-linked posts, replies, macro commentary and subscription promotions, plus weekly research schedules.
profile.revisits: ASTS conviction returns in 2099854813601169606 and 2100581412126466151; OSCR accumulation is revisited in 2100576480472305731.
profile.caveats: This is the September incremental window, not two months. Paid-service promotion and retrospective success claims create selection and marketing bias. Charts, private-group trades and claimed insider activity are not independently verified. Crypto and silver views are retained narratively rather than mapped to equity tickers. Supplied trading-day labels include weekends and next-day labels after close.

narrative: The window opens with conviction in ASTS and crypto while NBIS receives a partnership-linked technical endorsement. As inflation and the Fed decision dominate, the author stresses cash, safe havens and purchases in companies believed to have already corrected. ASTS and OSCR remain recurring high-conviction equity ideas, with ADUR presented as a patented technology opportunity. The author waits for support in HIMS and UNH and a later correction in NVDA. Chinese AI exposure through BABA and BIDU is an alternative to a slowing US cycle, although BABA capital spending is acknowledged as a cash-flow issue. ETH and silver become prominent rotation themes; after initially describing the Clarity Act as a possible catalyst, the author argues crypto does not depend on it. At the end of the capture the author still anticipates seasonal market weakness despite near-term relief. These are account claims rather than independently established events or company fundamentals.
